population: same pre-existing near-pair queries, no outcome selection
target: each individual 2-second displacement, not pair-relative displacement
split: day 1 train, day 2 test; ten-minute block intervals, same venue limitation
inputs: four causal 1Hz frames: pair-local position, velocity, measured facing sin/cos
control: identical input shape and tree capacity; removed columns zero-filled
gate: facing vs no-facing History >=5% improvement and upper confidence bound <0
limitation: offline information screen, no Bayesian or robot decision claim
